title: Shift Vacuum Furnace Preheating to Night Off-Peak Tariff Window
rationale: Furnace batch preheat currently coincides with State grid peak tariff window (18:00 - 22:00 @ ₹10.40/kWh). Shifting the ramp to 22:30 (off-peak @ ₹5.20/kWh) cuts electricity unit cost by 50% without altering production output.
actionSteps: Adjust MES scheduling recipe queue for Batch #401
Update SCADA automatic start timer to 22:30
Verify night shift operator pre-check checklist

title: Retrofit Air Compressor Air-End with Smart Modulation & VFD Tuning
rationale: Operating at fixed discharge pressure of 7.2 bar when plant tools require only 6.2 bar. Lowering system setpoint by 0.8 bar yields 6% direct shaft power savings across all 3 shifts.
actionSteps: Lower main header pressure transmitter setpoint from 7.2 to 6.4 bar
Retune PID gain parameters on variable speed drive inverter
Monitor line pressure drop at furthest CNC cell to confirm 6.0 bar minimum

title: Interlock Paint Booth Exhaust Blowers with Automated Conveyor Photo-Eyes
rationale: Ventilation exhaust fans operate at 100% capacity (36 kW) during shift breaks and chassis inter-batch gaps, wasting roughly 4.2 hours of idle power daily.
actionSteps: Deploy PLC logic block to drop VFD output to 20 Hz after 5 mins inactivity
Wire auxiliary relay from chassis entry optical sensor
Conduct smoke test to verify purge compliance within 45s of wake-up

title: Optimize Cooling Pump Impeller Trim & Open Throttled Discharge Valve
rationale: Pump P-102 discharge butterfly valve is 32% throttled, creating 1.2 bar artificial head loss. Modulating pump motor speed via existing drive eliminates throttling dissipation.
actionSteps: Open manual discharge butterfly valve to 100% full bore
Configure closed-loop differential pressure feedback to pump VFD
Confirm cooling tower basin level sensor calibration

title: Phase-2 Rooftop Solar PV Expansion (250 kWp Addition)
rationale: Unutilized Bay 4 & 5 rooftop structural capacity can host 580 high-efficiency TOPCon solar modules, offsetting 28% of daytime cooling tower and compressor electrical load.
actionSteps: Submit structural roof load feasibility assessment to plant engineering
Issue RFP for 250 kWp grid-tied string inverters with zero-export limiter
Schedule net-metering interconnection approval with DISCOM
